items.t: Engine failure from leftover machining debris (recall)
items.note: Lexus replaces the engine for free. The 2024 expansion's remedy was still being developed.

items.t: SUV can roll when left in neutral (recall)
Transmission shift solenoid failure can cause over-revving and power loss (recall)
Backup camera image freezes or goes blank (recall)
Stability control may stay off after restart (recall)
Passenger airbags can switch off from broken seat belt sensor wire (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace front passenger seat belt assembly (recall 18V-887)

items.t: Floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal and floor mat (recall 11V-113)

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)

items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: One owner paid $250 at a dealer; a coolant change alone runs about $470-$580.

items.t: Rear air conditioning leaks or stops cooling
items.job: Repair rear A/C refrigerant lines and recharge
items.note: Owners report $1,600 for rear line leaks and $2,000 for a rear A/C failure.

items.t: Height control (AHC) suspension sags or shows fault light
items.job: Replace AHC accumulators (globes) and service fluid
items.note: Owners report about $300-$800; used globes cost less.
One owner paid close to $600 at a dealer.

items.t: Rear axle oil leak soaks rear brakes
items.job: Reseal rear axle and replace oil-soaked rear brake parts

items.note: One owner was quoted $2,000 by a dealer and paid $800 using a refurbished unit.

items.t: Steering shaft can disconnect after hard impact (recall)
items.job: Install redesigned snap ring and retainer (recall 10V-346)

items.t: Side curtain airbags can deploy unexpectedly (recall)
Check engine light from oxygen sensors
items.note: Owners report $270 for one sensor and about $400 with an exhaust pipe; two catalytic converters ran about $740.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve cover and oil pan gaskets
items.note: RepairPal lists $264-$355 for an LX 570 valve cover gasket; an oil pan gasket on the LX 450 adds more.
